facebookresearch_moolib/examples/common/.compute_action_log_probs: compute action log probabilities from policy logits and sampled actions using softmax and NLL loss
facebookresearch_moolib/examples/common/.review_VTraceFromLogitsReturns_namedtupl: review the VTraceFromLogitsReturns namedtuple structure containing vs, pg_advantages, log_rhos, and action log probabilities
